title: Star Wars: Imperial Assault
subtitle: Epic tactical combat and branching cinematic campaign in the classic Star Wars galaxy
tagline: A galaxy in turmoil, heroic rebels, and the overwhelming might of the Galactic Empire
loreSummary: In the wake of the Death Star's destruction, the Galactic Empire strikes back across scattered star systems. You command an elite strike team of Rebel operatives waging guerrilla warfare, or direct infinite Imperial legions seeking to crush the uprising once and for all.
keyFeatures: Branching campaign mission tree with dynamic narrative consequences
Asymmetric 1-vs-many tactical grid combat or fully cooperative app play
Rebel hero advancement with distinct ability decks and equipment upgrades
Imperial commander agenda cards, secret military deployments, and nemesis allies

ia_core_campaign.name: Core Story Campaign
ia_core_campaign.description: The complete 11-mission campaign narrative: introductory mission, 4 branching story missions, 5 side missions, and the climactic sector finale.

ia_extended_campaign.name: Extended Galactic Conflict
ia_extended_campaign.description: Comprehensive 13-mission campaign incorporating unexpected Imperial forced missions, hostile ambushes, and agenda intercepts.

ia_coop_app_campaign.name: Flight to Freedom (App Co-op)
ia_coop_app_campaign.description: Focused 5-mission cooperative campaign driven by the official Star Wars: Legends of the Alliance companion digital app.

milestones.title: Infiltration & Aftermath
milestones.description: Rebel operatives infiltrate a remote Imperial transmission outpost following the destruction of the Death Star.

milestones.title: Imperial Escalation
milestones.description: Gathering vital rebel resources and securing key planetary alliances while evading Imperial patrols.

milestones.title: The Imperial Counteroffensive
milestones.description: Imperial high command retaliates with heavy mechanized walker divisions and elite forces.

milestones.title: Planetary Redoubt Finale
milestones.description: The decisive final assault against the Imperial stronghold determining the destiny of the sector.
